news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 4 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 4 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non Executive Independent Director Anubha Chauhan is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company’s lack of experienced directors is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 2 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 2 independent directors. 3 non-independent directors. Non-Executive Independent Director Ramanuj Darak was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.
